publication.title: The Sacred Books of China: The Texts of Confucianism. Part II. The Yî King

witness.pageMapping: Printed p = IA viewer index n(p+33) = one-based PDF page p+34; inherited judgment mapping and targeted page images cross-checked.

quality.judgmentReader: The same 64 historical reader strings are retained and now independently image-compared in the 2026-10-28 review. Their original ingestion path remains unrecorded; the new review does not invent it.
quality.lineReader: All 384 lines and both additional paragraphs independently read against the selected large-print body on all 154 source pages, followed by full comparison and explicit adjudication; not human/expert collation.
quality.targetedScanScope: Images were opened to inspect selected phrases, extraction boundaries or continuation. Listing a page does not assert every glyph on that page was checked.
quality.knownUncertainty: Five grouped typography/character-identity details remain documented in legge-1882-image-collation.json. Reader approximations are not diplomatic reproductions. Residual errors may remain.

imageCollation.scope: Selected large-print texts only, not every text layer on the page.

layers.sourceText: Selected upstream OCR tokens joined with spaces within OCR lines and newlines between lines/segments; numbering/headings/notes excluded. Not diplomatic transcription, not complete OCR XML; retains upstream OCR misreadings. sourceSegments records printed-page boundaries.
layers.reader: Whitespace and punctuation spacing normalized; line-break hyphenation joined except long-continued and self-produced; explicit scan-checked changes in corrections. Existing judgment strings retained. Some reader romanizations simplify accents/italics and the historical 3-shaped consonant to Z. In version 0.2.0 all 450 reader strings are retained after independent image comparison; the original 3-shaped Roman letter is represented by declared Z reading/search transliteration, not an exact Unicode glyph identity.
layers.heading: Modern site-authored navigation labels derived from line position/polarity; not verbatim Legge headings.
layers.name: Simplified Legge romanization only; English navigation glosses elsewhere in the site are modern metadata, not Legge chapter titles.

rights.historicalText: Public domain historical English translation (1882); no CC condition is imposed on the historical text.
rights.archiveStatus: Internet Archive item copyright-evidence states NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT (US); this is source evidence, not a universal jurisdictional legal guarantee.
rights.originalMetadata: Copyrightable original modern metadata, documentation and arrangement: CC BY 4.0, Chu, Chen-Yu / 曲宸宇 (GitHub poplolioi11); historical public-domain text remains unrestricted.
rights.images: Linked, not redistributed in this data package. Repository/institution image terms remain distinct.
rights.wikisource: Not a source of the exported text. Wikisource user-contributed editing/arrangement is not relicensed here.

aiUse.model: Underlying model identifier not exposed in this task; no guessed model version.
aiUse.work: Prior OCR extraction plus 2026-10-28 complete scoped independent AI image reading, full comparison, high-risk image adjudication and deterministic export.
aiUse.ocr: Existing Internet Archive OCR; engine/version not established by this import.
aiUse.humanReview: No independent human collation, expert review or peer review.

reviewModels.gemini: Gemini/Antigravity actual reported model gemini-3.8-flash-high for pp57–72.
reviewModels.nativeAgents: Fresh Codex sub-agents; requested gpt-6.1-sol ultra for pp73–104 and121–210, requested gpt-6-astra ultra for pp105–120 and critical adjudication. Native execution telemetry did not independently expose exact model identity/usage.
reviewModels.privateRecords: Detailed prompts, workers, processing code and full internal review logs are retained privately, not included in the public package.
